title: Report OS 1.12 to the computer (Overbridge)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only. A custom build names itself in the container's version field, which the bootstrap shows on the power-on screen and in TEST MODE and the main OS reports to the computer; Overbridge then refuses the unit as not running a compatible OS version. This mod makes the two sites that send the version out (the USB vendor request's version reply, built at init, and the reply to MidiRpcSoftwareVersionRequest) report a copy of the header with 1.12 in the version field. The power-on screen and TEST MODE still show the build's name; the build id and everything else are stock. For dn2-cfw.

sites.note: the init task FUN_400cedfc: jsr 0x40134850 (the header cache getter), then +8..+0x17 copied by FUN_40005906 to 0x40287ad5, the reply of USB vendor request 0xC0/0x02
FUN_40125f9e, MidiRpcSoftwareVersionRequest: jsr 0x40134850, then 4 bytes from +8 and 12 from +0x0C into the reply
